elements.text:
You had a really long day at school and are feeling tired, so you decide to stay home from the movie night at your friend's house. When you open social media, you see everyone posting about it on Snapchat.

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'm proud of myself for listening to my body's needs.
I feel a little sad not to be with my friends, but acknowledge that everyone needs rest sometimes.
I'm really regretting not pushing myself to go out.
I feel anxious that my friends are going to get closer without me, but remind myself that one night won't change things too much.
I'm excited to spend some time on self-care.
